sections.section: RULES - Balochistan Health Department (Basic Pay Scale 16 And Above) Service Rules 1984
sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH DEPARTMENT (BASIC
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH DEPARTMENT (BASIC
PAY SCALE 16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE RULES, 1984
(Substitution of Serial No.21 in the appendix
under heading B-18)
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
17th August, 2012]
No.S.O.(R-II)(8)12/2012-S&GAD/1465-1500, dated 17-8-2012.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 25 of the Balochistan Civil
Servants Act, 1974 (Act No.IX of 1974), the Government of Balochistan is
pleased to make the following amendments in the Balochistan Health Department
(Basic Pay Scale-16 and above) Service Rules, 1984, namely:--
In
the aforesaid rules, in appendix under heading B-18, for Serial No.21, the
following shall be substituted, namely:--
21
Optometrist (BPS-18)
(a) B.Sc. (Hon:)
Vision Sciences (Optometry) or B.Sc. in Optometry and Ophthalmic Technology
from a recognized University. (b) three years' post-qualification work
experience in the relevant field; and (c) Post Graduation in Optometry will
be preferred.
By initial
recruitment.
